create_openai_embedding_client: create an OpenAI embedding client that connects to a vLLM API server for generating text embeddings
run_list_available_models: run listing available models from the vLLM API server and retrieve the first model ID
create_embedding_for_texts: create embeddings for a list of input text strings using the OpenAI embeddings API
run_embedding_response_parser: run parsing embedding responses and printing each embedding vector as a list of floats
create_openai_client_config: create an OpenAI client configured with a custom API key and base URL pointing to vLLM
